segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: On behalf of LP Clubs, I'd like to welcome you all here today.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: My name's Sandy Fisher, and I'm one of the fitness managers here.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Before we start our tour of the club, I'll just run through some basic information about the facilities we have here, including recent improvements, and explain the types of membership available.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Our greatest asset is probably our swimming pool, which at 25 metres isn't Olympic sized, but now we've expanded it to eight lanes, it's much wider.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: This means there are rarely more than a couple of people at a time in each lane.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Unfortunately, there isn't space for an outdoor pool here, but the glass roof on the swimming pool is partly retractable, which means you can enjoy something of the open air experience on warmer days.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Our recently refurbished fitness suite has all the latest exercise equipment, including 10 new running machines and a wide range of weight training machines.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Each member is given full training in how to operate the equipment, and there is always a trainer on duty to offer help and advice.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Although we do have adult only times after six and at certain times at weekends, children are well catered for.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Older children continue to benefit from a wide range of tuition, anything from trampolining to yoga.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Before you hear the rest of the talk, you have some time to look at questions 13 to 20.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Now listen and answer questions 13 to 20.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: One thing all our members appreciate about us is that we take very good care of them.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: This starts on day one with your personal assessment.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: You are asked to fill in a questionnaire giving details of any health problems.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: One of our personal trainers will then go through this with you.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The trainer will then take you through the safety rules for using the equipment in the fitness suite.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: During your next exercise session, a personal trainer will work with you to make sure you understand these.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: It's very important to do this because we really do want to avoid having any sports injuries.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: There's a lot more to looking after yourself than simply lifting weights.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: At the end of the personal assessment, the trainer will draw up a plan outlining what you should try to achieve within a six week period.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: This will then be reviewed at the end of the six weeks.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Now I'll just quickly run through the types of membership we have available.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: All members must pay a joining fee of £90 in addition to the rates for the monthly membership fees.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Gold membership entitles you to free entry at all LP clubs.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: There are now LP clubs in all major cities and towns, so if you travel a lot, this will be a great advantage.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Individual gold membership costs £50 a month, and joint membership for you and your partner will cost £75.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Premier membership is for professional people whose work commitments make it difficult for them to use the club during the day, and so LP gives booking preferences to Premier members at peak times.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: This means you will find it easier to book the sessions at times that suit you.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Reciprocal arrangements with other LP clubs are available to premier members.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Premier membership is for individuals only, but you'll be sent passes for guests every month.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The monthly fee is £65.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: You don't have to have any special clothes or equipment when you visit the club.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: We provide robes and hair dryers in the changing rooms, but it's very important to remember your photo card because you won't be able to get in without it.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: For people who aren't working during the day, then you should That is the end of section two.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: You now have half a minute to check your answers.
